That’s why we created Yummybara Pantries. Thoughtfully bundled around how families actually snack.

settings.heading: Every Pantry Comes With A Little Extra.
settings.text:
Because snack time can get messy.

Every Yummybara Pantry includes complimentary Habibara wipes to help parents handle sticky fingers, messy mouths, and everyday adventures.

The bigger the pantry, the bigger the bonus! Unlike ordinary wipes that simply clean, Habibara wipes are made with pure EDI water and skin-loving botanical ingredients to care for your little one's delicate skin while keeping them fresh and comfortable.

settings.heading: Your child deserves snacks built for them. Not just free from the worst.
settings.description: Every Singapore parent who's stood in the baby food aisle knows the exhaustion of choosing by elimination - picking the one with the least to object to, not the one most designed for their child. StageWise™ ends that search.
settings.question_1: Q: My child is 10 months - which age range do I choose?
settings.answer_1: A: Start with the 6m+ range. For 10 months, the serving guidance recommends 3–5 melts per serving, up to 3 times per week. The 12m+ range becomes appropriate as your child develops stronger chewing ability around 12 months. The Gentle Tummy Bundle and Snack Explorer Box are both ideal first introductions for this age.
settings.question_2: Q: What makes StageWise™ different from other freeze-dried baby snacks?
settings.answer_2: A: Most freeze-dried baby snacks use the preservation method but don't engineer around it. StageWise™ is built on the melt-on-contact behaviour, used deliberately as a safety and acceptance feature. It's the only system with age-calibrated formulation (6m+, 12m+, 18m+), inulin prebiotic + probiotic strains integrated into the base formulation, and up to 97% nutrient retention.
settings.question_3: Q: My baby already has a good snack routine. Why should I switch?
settings.answer_3: A: You don't have to switch everything. If your current snacks are working - no rejection, no tummy issues, no label anxiety - you may not need to change anything. But if any of those are present, the formulation gap is almost always why. Try the Snack Explorer Box as a low-commitment way to discover the difference.
settings.question_4: Q: Are Yummybara snacks Halal certified?
settings.answer_4: A: Yes. All Yummybara products are Halal certified. This is a non-negotiable product standard, displayed clearly on every product box - not an optional add-on.
settings.question_5: Q: What if my child rejects the snack?
settings.answer_5: A: Yummybara's texture is engineered for acceptance - gentler textures at the start remove the texture barrier that causes most early rejections. If your child doesn't take to a particular flavour, the Snack Explorer Box gives you five distinct fruit varieties to discover what your child gravitates to.
settings.question_6: Q: How quickly will we see a difference in tummy comfort?
settings.answer_6: A: Many parents notice a difference within 1–2 weeks of consistent snacking - particularly a reduction in digestive upsets and more predictable gut responses. Inulin prebiotic and probiotic support is cumulative; the daily snacking habit is the delivery mechanism.
settings.question_7: Q: Where can I buy Yummybara in Singapore?
settings.answer_7: A: Available online with island-wide delivery. We're also stocked at select retailers - check our stockist page for locations near you. Online orders include full age-range guidance and direct parent support.
settings.question_8: Q: Is the price the same as buying the boxes one by one?
settings.answer_8: A: No. Standard is about 10% less than the boxes bought separately, and the Value pack about 15% less. The "bought separately" price is shown beside every size.

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questiond
settings.question_1: My child is 9 months. Which bundle?
settings.answer_1: 8 months+. It is built for a child with few or no teeth, and everything in it melts on contact. Move up to 10 months+ when your child is holding food and gnawing on it, usually around 10 months. If you are between ages, pick the younger one.
settings.question_2: My child is 11 months. Is 10 months+ or 12 months+ right?
settings.answer_2: 10 months+. The 12 months+ bundle has filled sticks and wafers that need proper chewing. Go up at 12 months, or later if your child is still working on chewing.
settings.question_3: What if my child does not like a flavour?
settings.answer_3: Every bundle has several flavours, so one miss does not waste the bundle. Most rejections at this age come down to texture rather than taste, which is why the texture is matched to the age first.
settings.answer_4: Yes, and every box lists them. The melts contain milk. The Jumbo Filled Rice Sticks contain wheat, milk and egg. The Shrimp Wafer Crisps contain crustaceans. Some products are made in a facility that also handles soybean, peanuts, tree nuts, fish and crustaceans. Check the box for your child's allergy before serving.
settings.question_5: How do I store it, and how long does it keep?
settings.answer_5: Cool, dry place, away from heat and sunlight. Reseal an open pack and finish it within 30 days. Unopened, the melts keep 18 months and most other products 12 months.
